body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one creature within weapon range. On a success, deal 1 weapon damage and record the Defense it used against this Action.

surges.html: If the target has any Condition, this Action ignores 1 Defense.
Repeat one non-damage utility effect of this Action on a second eligible target.

rider.title: REVERSAL CONTINGENCY
rider.html: After resolving this Action, you may establish this Contingency. Trigger: The chosen creature uses a Reaction. Effect: It burns 1 die after that Reaction resolves.
rider.meta: EXPIRES: START OF YOUR NEXT TURN
